name: What should I ask before hiring a whole-house remodeling contractor?

mainEntity.name: What questions help me find the right contractor for a luxury whole-house remodel?
mainEntity.text: What questions help me find the right contractor for a luxury whole-house remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring the right contractor for a whole-house remodel starts with asking practical questions about experience and process. Homeowners should ask whether the contractor has completed projects similar in size, scope, and finish level. It is also important to know who will supervise the job daily, how communication works, and how changes are approved and priced. Other key questions include how permits are handled, what is included in the bid, what the payment schedule looks like, and what warranty is provided after completion. For luxury projects, ask about subcontractor quality, material lead times, and how the team protects the home during construction. The best contractor is not just a builder but a coordinator who can manage design, scheduling, inspections, and quality control. A detailed answer to these questions usually reveals whether the company is organized enough for a complex whole-house project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about similar project experience, license and insurance, who manages the job daily, permit handling, payment schedule, change orders, warranty, and expected timeline. Also ask for examples of completed whole-house remodels similar in size and style.
